---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a coaching signal or capability
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The coaching question you want answered**
e.g. "Am I over-walling on open maps?" / "Show my villager count vs my opponent over time."

**What data would it need**
Is it derivable from the command stream / timeseries we already parse, or does it need
something new? (See CLAUDE.md for what each backend exposes.)

**Anything else**
Sketches, examples, links to similar tools welcome.
